book.name: 2a de Tesalonicenses
book.title: Yech mrop kwaan mkee Pab lo re xaa yezh Tesalónica

content: Pab nzaa kwent cho gor bare Jesucrist
Lee nal wech nu bzan, kaza na kwent cho gor bare Jesucrist, Xaa Nabeyy be, leezha zhaal be kwaan lee xaa. Naab nu lo re gu,

nagakt chop yek gu nixa nalet gu xgab, gorna gon gu lee tub xaa yé: “Lee mbizh kwaan bare Xaa Nabeyy mzhinla”. Chelee tub xaa yé: “Mlu Mbi Naban kwaane lo na”, o chelee xaa yé xaa: “Stub xaa snee mbin na nzhé”, o chelee xaa yé xaa: “Mkayaa na tub yech kwaan mkee Pab paro nzaa Pab kwent lee mbizh bare Xaa Nabeyy mzhinla”, nalet gu krera.

Nalaat gu kade nik tub xaa gu lo re kwaane. Nel yilotlaka leezha zeeraka zhin mbizh kwaan bare Xaa Nabeyy, nkin zhin re mbizh leezha zyen doo xaa laa Dios. Nu lee re mbizh ne klar doo luu cho nak xaa tira nanont ley lo, xaa kwaan nakla kwent lux.
Xaa ne gak xkontrad rese dios kwaan nzholl myet lo, nu xaa ne gak gaya lo rese dios cheen myet. Nu axta ya xaa nu zob xaa leen yidoo cheen Dios nu yé xaa lee xaa nak Dios.
¿Che nanselazht gu mzala na kwent kwaane lo gu leezha nzoka na lo re gu?
Nu nela gu nzho tub yalnabeyy kwaan nle zee nyent mod zhin xaa tira nanont ley lo nal, xaa ne luu axta mbizh kwaan nzhaal luu xaa.
Kwaanzee nal lee xgab cheen Maxuu kayak, kwaan ngu xlaan dubse yilo. Nebse nzho jwalt kwe Dios xaa kwaan nanzaat diizh gak kwaan tira nawent.
Gorzee lee xaa tira nanont ley lo gakbeyy lo re myet. Nu lee Jesús, Xaa Nabeyy be, gut xaa ne nebse kwaan xtizh xaa, nu lux Jesús xaa ne gorna yaad Jesús kwaan re xni chul cheen xaa.
Nu leezha zeeraka yaad Jesucrist, lee xaa tira nanont ley lo gakbeyy, nu kwaan yalngezh cheen Maxuu, le xaa zyen doo nseyn gro, re kwaan dedyall rese myet wii.
Nu noka kade xaa ne rese myet, xaa nya naz lo ki; nel nangzeyalt re xaa ne kayaa kwaan wli, zee ngla xaa lo yalgut.
Nel nanzheklat re xaa ne ngon kwaan wli, kwaanzee mlaa Dios xaa zee mkade xaa xaa, zee mreke xaa tich kwaan nawlit.
Kwaanzee Dios xaal re xaa ned ne ded bid doo lo ki nel namzaat xaa yek xaa gon xaa re kwaan wli, nu mas nyulara xaa re kwaan nanalit.
Re xaa mleey Dios le gan yalnaban

Wech nu bzan, lee re nu tubka nzaa dixkix lo Dios kwent cheen gu, nel tant nkedoola Xaa Nabeyy gu. Nu axta yilo mleey xaa gu zee le gu gan yalnaban kwaan tira, nel lee Mbi Naban nkee zhiin leen lextoo gu, nu mle nambey xaa gu, nel tubka nreke gu tich re kwaan wli.
Kwaanzee mrezh Dios gu kwaan wdizh chul kwaan mzaa nu kwent lo gu, zee noka re gu nzho mod ded axta lo xni cheen Jesucrist, Xaa Nabeyy be.
Kwaanzee wech nu bzan, tubka sbaa nye zo gu lo Dios nu nayenlazht gu re kwaan mseed nu gu, nu re kwaan mkee nu lo yech.
Nzhekla na zee lee Jesucrist, Xaa Nabeyy be, nu lee Xuz be Dios xaa nkela be nu xaa tira nseleyy be, nu xaa nle zee nzho mod kwaz be le xaa rese kwaan né xaa,
le zee yo balor lextoo be nu le zee tubka nali zo be lo xaa, zee rese kwaan yé be nu rese kwaan le be gak kwaan wen.
